blocks.en: Any self-respecting physicist ``knows\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ that the solution to \eqref{eq:semigroup-motivation-abstract-heat-ode} is $\exp(At)u_0$. For mathematicians, life is not as simple: we have to face the annoying issue of giving a meaning to $\exp(At)$. The theory of semigroups of linear operators generalizes the notion of the exponential matrix (or, for nonautonomous problems, the fundamental matrix) to problems in infinite-dimensional spaces involving unbounded operators. As a preparation, we review various ways that the exponential matrix can be defined in finite dimensions and we tentatively assess their potential of being generalizable to infinite dimensions.
blocks.zh: 任何有自尊心的物理学家都 ``知道\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ \eqref{eq:semigroup-motivation-abstract-heat-ode} 的解为 $\exp(At)u_0$. 对数学家而言, 事情却没那么简单: 必须面对赋予 $\exp(At)$ 意义这一恼人的问题. 线性算子半群理论将矩阵指数 (或对非自治问题而言的基本矩阵) 的概念推广到无限维空间中涉及无界算子的问题. 作为准备, 回顾有限维情形下定义矩阵指数的各种方法, 并初步评估它们推广到无限维情形的可能性.

blocks.en: Strongly Continuous Semigroups
blocks.zh: 强连续半群
blocks.label: subsec:strongly-continuous-semigroups

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If $A$ is an $n\times n$ matrix, we have $\exp(A(t+s))=\exp(At)\exp(As)$, i.e., the matrices $\exp(At)$, $t\geq0$, form a \emph{semigroup}. We shall consider families of bounded linear operators with the same property.
blocks.zh: 若 $A$ 为 $n\times n$ 矩阵, 则有 $\exp(A(t+s))=\exp(At)\exp(As)$, 即矩阵 $\exp(At)$, $t\geq0$, 构成一个\emph{半群}. 将考虑具有相同性质的有界线性算子族.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $X$ be a Banach space. A family $\{T(t)\}$, $t\geq0$, of bounded linear operators in $X$ is called a \textbf{strongly continuous semigroup} or \textbf{$C_0$-semigroup}, if it satisfies the following properties:\begin{enumerate}\item\label{hyp:semigroup-composition-law} $T(t+s)=T(t)T(s)$, $t,s\geq0$,\item\label{hyp:semigroup-zero-identity} $T(0)=I$,\item\label{hyp:semigroup-orbit-continuity} for every $x\in X$,\[[0,\infty)\ni t\mapsto T(t)x\in X\]is continuous.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 为 Banach 空间. 若 $X$ 中的有界线性算子族 $\{T(t)\}$, $t\geq0$, 满足以下性质, 则称它为\textbf{强连续半群}或 \textbf{$C_0$ 半群}:\begin{enumerate}\item\label{hyp:semigroup-composition-law} $T(t+s)=T(t)T(s)$, $t,s\geq0$,\item\label{hyp:semigroup-zero-identity} $T(0)=I$,\item\label{hyp:semigroup-orbit-continuity} 对每个 $x\in X$,\[[0,\infty)\ni t\mapsto T(t)x\in X\]连续.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: def:strongly-continuous-semigroup

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It can be shown that instead of condition~\ref{hyp:semigroup-orbit-continuity}, it is sufficient to require continuity of $T(t)x$ at $t=0$. The uniform boundedness principle can then be used to show that $\|T(t)\|$ is bounded in a neighborhood of zero. Having this, the semigroup property yields that $\|T(t)\|$ is bounded on any finite interval. Now continuity of $T(t)x$ from the right follows immediately from the semigroup property, and continuity from the left can be shown by using the identity $T(t-h)-T(t)=T(t-h)(I-T(h))$. We leave the details of the argument to the reader; see Problem~\ref{ex:semigroup-continuity-at-zero-details}.
blocks.zh: 可以证明, 不必要求条件~\ref{hyp:semigroup-orbit-continuity}, 只需要求 $T(t)x$ 在 $t=0$ 处连续. 再由一致有界原理可证明 $\|T(t)\|$ 在零的某邻域内有界. 有了这一点, 半群性质便给出 $\|T(t)\|$ 在任意有限区间上有界. 现在, $T(t)x$ 的右连续性直接由半群性质得到, 而左连续性可利用恒等式 $T(t-h)-T(t)=T(t-h)(I-T(h))$ 证明. 论证细节留给读者; 见 Problem~\ref{ex:semigroup-continuity-at-zero-details}.
blocks.label: rem:semigroup-continuity-at-zero

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If $A$ is a bounded operator in $X$, then $\exp(At)$ can be defined using, for example, the power series. It is easy to see that the operators $\exp(At)$ form a strongly continuous semigroup. In fact, $\exp(At)$ is even continuous in the norm topology, not just strongly; i.e.,\[[0,\infty)\ni t\mapsto\exp(At)\in\mathcal{L}(X)\]is continuous. Such semigroups are referred to as uniformly continuous. It can be shown that every uniformly continuous semigroup is of the form $\exp(At)$, where $A$ is a bounded operator. Since this result has little interest for PDEs, we shall not prove it.
blocks.zh: 若 $A$ 为 $X$ 中的有界算子, 则例如可用幂级数定义 $\exp(At)$. 容易看出, 算子 $\exp(At)$ 构成强连续半群. 实际上, $\exp(At)$ 不仅强连续, 甚至在范数拓扑下连续; 即\[[0,\infty)\ni t\mapsto\exp(At)\in\mathcal{L}(X)\]连续. 这样的半群称为一致连续半群. 可以证明, 每个一致连续半群都具有 $\exp(At)$ 的形式, 其中 $A$ 为有界算子. 由于这一结果对 PDE 的意义不大, 这里不予证明.
blocks.label: ex:bounded-generator-uniformly-continuous-semigroup

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $X=L^2(\mathbb{R})$, and define $(T(t)u)(x)=u(x+t)$. Then $\{T(t)\}$, $t\geq0$, is a strongly continuous semigroup. It is not uniformly continuous; indeed, we have $\|T(t)-T(s)\|=2$ whenever $t\neq s$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X=L^2(\mathbb{R})$, 并定义 $(T(t)u)(x)=u(x+t)$. 则 $\{T(t)\}$, $t\geq0$, 为强连续半群. 它并不一致连续; 实际上, 只要 $t\neq s$, 就有 $\|T(t)-T(s)\|=2$.
blocks.label: ex:ltwo-translation-semigroup

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $X=C_b(\mathbb{R})$, and let $T(t)$ be as in the previous example. Then $T(t)$ is not strongly continuous; the convergence of $T(t)u$ to $u$ as $t\to0$ need not be uniform on $\mathbb{R}$. (The reader should construct a counterexample: a function $u(x)$ for which one does not have $\lim_{t\to0}T(t)u=0$. Try a function consisting of a sequence of increasingly narrow ``bumps\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ of unit height.)
blocks.zh: 设 $X=C_b(\mathbb{R})$, 且 $T(t)$ 如前一例. 则 $T(t)$ 不强连续; 当 $t\to0$ 时, $T(t)u$ 到 $u$ 的收敛未必在 $\mathbb{R}$ 上一致. (读者应构造一个反例: 一个不满足 $\lim_{t\to0}T(t)u=0$ 的函数 $u(x)$. 试用由一列越来越窄且高度为一的 ``凸起\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 构成的函数.)
blocks.label: ex:bounded-continuous-translation-not-strongly-continuous

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We conclude this subsection with a result on the growth of $\|T(t)\|$ for strongly continuous semigroups. As a preparation we need a lemma.
blocks.zh: 以关于强连续半群的 $\|T(t)\|$ 的增长的结果结束本小节. 作为准备, 需要一个引理.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\omega:[0,\infty)\to\mathbb{R}$ be bounded above on every finite interval and subadditive (i.e., $\omega(t_1+t_2)\leq\omega(t_1)+\omega(t_2)$). Then\[\inf_{t>0}\omega(t)/t=\lim_{t\to\infty}\omega(t)/t;\](it is understood that both sides in this equation may be $-\infty$).
blocks.zh: 设 $\omega:[0,\infty)\to\mathbb{R}$ 在每个有限区间上有上界且次可加 (即 $\omega(t_1+t_2)\leq\omega(t_1)+\omega(t_2)$). 则\[\inf_{t>0}\omega(t)/t=\lim_{t\to\infty}\omega(t)/t;\](这里允许等式两端均为 $-\infty$).
blocks.label: lem:subadditive-growth-limit

blocks.en: The Infinitesimal Generator
blocks.zh: 无穷小生成元
blocks.label: subsec:semigroup-infinitesimal-generator

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Our motivation for studying semigroups of operators was to generalize the matrix exponential. This naturally raises the question whether every strongly continuous semigroup is, in a sense to be made precise, given as $\exp(At)$ for some operator $A$. We shall answer this question affirmatively. We begin with the following definition.
blocks.zh: 研究算子半群的动机是推广矩阵指数. 这自然提出一个问题: 是否每个强连续半群都可以在某种有待明确的意义下, 写成某个算子 $A$ 的 $\exp(At)$. 将对这一问题给出肯定回答. 先给出以下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: def:semigroup-infinitesimal-generator

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Of course it is not clear from this definition that $\mathcal{D}(A)$ contains anything but 0. The notion of infinitesimal generator would be of little interest unless $\mathcal{D}(A)$ is suitably large. We shall see that $\mathcal{D}(A)$ is actually dense in $X$. As a preparation, we shall establish a number of facts which will also be useful for other purposes.
blocks.zh: 当然, 从这一定义还看不出 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 除 0 以外是否还包含其他元素. 除非 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 足够大, 无穷小生成元这一概念就没有多大意义. 将看到 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 实际上在 $X$ 中稠密. 作为准备, 将建立若干对其他目的也有用的事实.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: lem:semigroup-generator-four-identities

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $A$ be the infinitesimal generator of a $C_0$-semigroup. Then $\mathcal{D}(A)$ is dense and $A$ is closed.
blocks.zh: 设 $A$ 为 $C_0$ 半群的无穷小生成元. 则 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 稠密, 且 $A$ 为闭算子.
blocks.label: thm:semigroup-generator-dense-closed

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $X=L^2(\mathbb{R})$ and $(T(t)u)(x)=u(x+t)$. Then the infinitesimal generator is $A=\mathrm{d}/\mathrm{d}x$ and its domain is $H^1(\mathbb{R})$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X=L^2(\mathbb{R})$, 且 $(T(t)u)(x)=u(x+t)$. 则无穷小生成元为 $A=\mathrm{d}/\mathrm{d}x$, 其定义域为 $H^1(\mathbb{R})$.

blocks.en: Clearly \eqref{eq:semigroup-variation-of-constants-formula} makes sense under much weaker assumptions. For example, \eqref{eq:semigroup-variation-of-constants-formula} represents a continuous function of $t$ if we only assume that $u_0\in X$ and $f\in L^1([0,T];X)$. This motivates the following definition.
blocks.zh: 显然, 在弱得多的假设下, \eqref{eq:semigroup-variation-of-constants-formula} 也有意义. 例如, 只要假设 $u_0\in X$ 且 $f\in L^1([0,T];X)$, \eqref{eq:semigroup-variation-of-constants-formula} 就表示 $t$ 的一个连续函数. 由此引出以下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Assume that $u_0\in X$ and $f\in L^1([0,T];X)$. Then $u(t)$ as given by \eqref{eq:semigroup-variation-of-constants-formula} is called a \textbf{mild solution} of \eqref{eq:semigroup-abstract-inhomogeneous-initial-value-problem}.
blocks.zh: 假设 $u_0\in X$ 且 $f\in L^1([0,T];X)$. 则 \eqref{eq:semigroup-variation-of-constants-formula} 给出的 $u(t)$ 称为 \eqref{eq:semigroup-abstract-inhomogeneous-initial-value-problem} 的\textbf{温和解}.
blocks.label: def:semigroup-mild-solution

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Naturally, we shall henceforth consider the mild solution a ``solution,\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ regardless of whether or not it is indeed a classical solution. However, regularity of solutions is of some interest, and we shall now look into the question of when we can assert that the solution is classical. This question is answered by the following theorem.
blocks.zh: 自然地, 今后无论温和解实际上是否为经典解, 都将其视为一个 ``解\textquotesingle\textquotesingle. 然而, 解的正则性也值得关注, 现在考察何时能断言解为经典解. 下面的定理回答这一问题.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Assume that $u_0\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, $f\in C([0,T];X)$ and that in addition either $f\in W^{1,1}([0,T];X)$ or $f\in L^1([0,T];\mathcal{D}(A))$. Then the mild solution of \eqref{eq:semigroup-abstract-inhomogeneous-initial-value-problem} is a classical solution.
blocks.zh: 假设 $u_0\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, $f\in C([0,T];X)$, 且另外满足 $f\in W^{1,1}([0,T];X)$ 或 $f\in L^1([0,T];\mathcal{D}(A))$. 则 \eqref{eq:semigroup-abstract-inhomogeneous-initial-value-problem} 的温和解为经典解.
blocks.label: thm:semigroup-mild-solution-classical-regularity
